description: This file defines classes related to configuring and validating grain types in Orleans, including options for grain classes and interfaces, a default provider for these options, and a validator to ensure proper configuration.

classes.name: GrainTypeOptions
classes.description: Holds collections of grain class and interface types for configuration purposes.

classes.name: DefaultGrainTypeOptionsProvider
classes.description: Provides default configuration for GrainTypeOptions based on type manifest options.

classes.name: GrainTypeOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates that GrainTypeOptions are correctly configured, ensuring presence of grain interfaces and classes.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures GrainTypeOptions by adding interface and class types based on the type manifest options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that grain interfaces and classes are configured; throws exceptions if not.
